# INTRO

Continuing with the Manila clam (_R.philippinarum_) RNA which [I quantified and pooled yesterday (20261027)](../2026-10-27-RNA-Quantification---R.philippinarum-Gill-RNA-from-2008-Using-Qubit-High-Sensitivity-RNA-Assay/index.qmd), today I performed reverse transcription using the GoScript Reverse Transcription Kit (Promega).


# MATERIALS & METHODS

I ran the GoScript Reverse Transcription Kit (Promega) according to the manufacturer's protocol using the pooled Manila clam RNA, but I tripled the reaction volume (20uL -> 60uL) to accommodate the number of qPCR reactions I would need to run with the 13 primer sets, in triplicate, which we'll be testing.


## Protocol

Briefly,

1. RNA denaturation and primer annealing.

- 300ng of total RNA
- oligo dT primers
- final volume = 15uL
- incubated 70<sup>o</sup>C 5mins
- put on ice water for at least 5mins

2. Reverse transcription

- final volume 60uL
- incubated 25<sup>o</sup>C 5mins
- incubated 42<sup>o</sup>C 60mins
- incubated 70<sup>o</sup>C 15mins


::: {.callout-important}

Final incubation (inactivation) is _required_ for successful downstream qPCR analysis!

:::
